text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp, entering its final 
stretch—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
How was it, Trainer? My running just now, 
I mean.
choice_data_list:
Yeah, it felt even more powerful than 
before...!

Yeah, that was even more powerful than 
before...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Lucky Lilac's ankle swelling is going 
down faster than expected, and she's 
steadily adapting to the physical changes 
brought on by her growth period."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she keeps this up, she should be able 
to head into the Shuka Sho having shown 
tremendous growth...!
choice_data_list: You really gave it your all, Luck...!
You really worked so hard, Luck...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, aren't you getting a bit ahead of 
yourself? The Shuka Sho is still a ways 
off, you know?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. It was only with your 
help, Trainer, that I was able to endure 
this summer.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Please look forward to the Shuka Sho. 
I'll definitely blossom out there."
choice_data_list:
There's never been a time I didn't have 
faith in you, you know.

It's not like I've ever stopped having 
faith in you, though.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Theeeeere you go saying that again. 
Honestly, you've got quite the tongue on 
you.
choice_data_list: Raw wheat, raw lice, raw eggs!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"That's not what I meant by 'quick'! And 
beside that, ya bit your tongue just 
now!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The summer training camp is coming to 
an end.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I know I can go further...! I can get even 
stronger...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Triple Tiara. They gather for its 
final stage, the Shuka Sho."
